articles.title: Joint-Preserving Percutaneous Kirschner-Wire Arthrorisis for Chronic Lesser Toe Metatarsophalangeal Dislocation.
articles.authors: Piclet-Legre B, Frey-Ollivier S, Amsellem-Avines D, Helix-Giordanino M, Chausse T, Micicoi L
articles.population: Patients with chronic lesser toe metatarsophalangeal joint dislocation (grades 3-4)
articles.outcomes: European Foot and Ankle Society score, Simple Foot and Ankle Value score, patient satisfaction, footwear accommodation, radiographic consolidation, residual deformity, complications
articles.take_home: A minimally invasive surgical technique using Kirschner wires successfully stabilised chronic toe joint dislocations in 57 feet, with 94% of patients satisfied and 77% able to return to normal shoes, though postoperative stiffness occurred in about 40% of cases.

articles.title: Functional surgery plus rehabilitation versus physical exercise alone for Charcot-Marie-Tooth cavovarus foot deformity: a retrospective cohort study.
articles.authors: Wei Z, Cui Z, Cao Y, Li X, Fu Y, Bai L, et al.
articles.population: Patients with Charcot-Marie-Tooth cavovarus foot deformity
articles.sample_size: 109 patients (55 functional surgery plus rehabilitation, 54 physical exercise alone)
articles.outcomes: 10-Meter Walk Test, 6-Minute Walk Test, walking disability (Walk-12, FADI), quality of life (SF-12), ankle mobility, falls, callus formation, and mobility aid use
articles.take_home: Both surgery with rehabilitation and exercise alone improved walking ability in the short term. At 2 years, surgery with rehabilitation reduced falls, calluses, and need for mobility aids, whilst exercise alone did not produce these sustained improvements.

articles.title: Hallux valgus: The multidimensional perspective.
articles.authors: Micicoi L, Bernasconi A, Welck M, Grun W, Vermorel PH, Luo E, et al.
articles.population: People with symptomatic hallux valgus (bunions) and control participants without the condition
articles.sample_size: 61 symptomatic hallux valgus feet and 60 control feet
articles.outcomes: Diagnostic accuracy of a new multidimensional metric (MDHV) combining three measurements of bunion deformity, compared with individual measurements
articles.take_home: A new combined measurement method that uses three different angles to assess bunions was more accurate at identifying the condition than any single measurement alone. However, this measurement tool helps assess how severe a bunion is but does not determine whether someone needs surgery, which remains a clinical decision.

articles.title: Ultrasound-guided hyaluronic acid injection for ankle osteoarthritis and osteochondral lesions of the talus: A retrospective clinical series.
articles.authors: Benegas I, Vargas E, de Albert M, Altayo M, Duarri G, Maled I, et al.
articles.population: Patients with ankle osteoarthritis and osteochondral lesions of the talus
articles.outcomes: Pain relief measured by visual analogue scale at 3 and 6 months; proportion of patients achieving meaningful pain improvement; time before needing further treatment
articles.take_home: Ultrasound-guided hyaluronic acid injections reduced ankle pain in the short term, with about two-thirds of patients experiencing meaningful improvement at 3 months. Most patients were able to delay further treatment for around 2 years.
